theme.en: AI's Memory Push Meets New Supply Constraints
theme.zh: AI存储扩张遭遇新的供应约束

dek.en: Custom HBM brings advanced logic manufacturing further into the memory supply chain, while competition for EUV tools and reported H200 import delays constrain expansion. TSMC's denial of a 3D DRAM initiative also qualifies expectations of new memory supply.
dek.zh: 定制HBM推动先进逻辑制造进一步介入存储供应链，但EUV设备争夺和据报出现的H200进口延迟制约扩张。台积电否认开展3D DRAM生产探索，也为新增存储供给的预期划定了边界。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Nvidia's Custom HBM Reportedly Involves Samsung and TSMC in 3nm Base Dies
title.zh: 据报道，Nvidia定制HBM引入三星与台积电参与3nm基底芯片开发

summary.en: Nvidia's custom NVHBM effort involves Samsung and TSMC in 3nm base-die development, Wccftech reports. Using an advanced logic process for the base die would extend HBM competition further into the foundry supply chain. The report also notes TSMC's denial of the separate claim that it plans to manufacture 3D DRAM.
summary.zh: 据Wccftech报道，Nvidia的定制NVHBM项目涉及三星与台积电参与3nm基底芯片开发。基底芯片采用先进逻辑制程，将推动HBM竞争进一步延伸至晶圆代工供应链。报道同时指出，台积电已否认另一项关于其计划制造3D DRAM的说法。

title.en: ASRock Rack Shows Diamond Rapids Board With 16 DDR5 Channels
title.zh: ASRock Rack展示支持16通道DDR5的Diamond Rapids主板

summary.en: ASRock Rack's DMRD16-2L+ motherboard for Intel Diamond Rapids exposes 16 DDR5 memory channels and 128 PCIe Gen6 lanes through MCIO connections, ServeTheHome reports. The board provides a concrete view of the platform's memory and I/O design, both relevant to servers moving large data sets and supporting attached accelerators.
summary.zh: 据ServeTheHome报道，面向Intel Diamond Rapids的ASRock Rack DMRD16-2L+主板提供16通道DDR5内存，并通过MCIO连接引出128条PCIe Gen6通道。这块主板具体展示了该平台的内存与I/O设计，两者都关系到服务器处理大规模数据和连接加速器的能力。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC Denies Exploring 3D DRAM Production at Nvidia's Request
title.zh: 台积电否认应Nvidia要求探索3D DRAM生产

summary.en: TSMC denies reports that it is exploring 3D DRAM production at Nvidia's request, Tom's Hardware reports. The response undercuts expectations that the foundry will provide a new source of DRAM supply on the strength of those reports. Fabricating HBM logic base dies is a separate role from producing the memory cells.
summary.zh: 据Tom's Hardware报道，台积电否认了其应Nvidia要求探索3D DRAM生产的说法。这一回应削弱了此前报道所引发的、台积电将成为DRAM新增供应来源的预期。制造HBM逻辑基底芯片与生产存储单元属于不同环节。

title.en: Researchers Control Nucleation Sites in 2D Single-Crystal Semiconductor Growth
title.zh: 研究人员控制二维单晶半导体生长的成核位置

summary.en: Researchers report control over nucleation sites during growth of two-dimensional single-crystal semiconductors, according to Bioengineer.org. Choosing where crystals start growing could make material placement more predictable for device fabrication, a useful step toward integrating 2D semiconductor channels.
summary.zh: 据Bioengineer.org报道，研究人员实现了对二维单晶半导体生长过程中成核位置的控制。选择晶体开始生长的位置，有望提高器件制造中材料分布的可预测性，为集成二维半导体沟道提供工艺基础。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Memory Suppliers Eye Record Q4 Revenue as HBM Prices Rise
title.zh: HBM价格上涨，存储供应商有望创下第四季度收入纪录

summary.en: Memory suppliers may reach record fourth-quarter revenue as HBM prices rise, TokenPost reports. The outlook suggests stronger pricing can support supplier revenue while raising procurement costs for AI hardware buyers; it remains a forecast rather than a reported quarterly result.
summary.zh: 据TokenPost报道，随着HBM价格上涨，存储供应商第四季度收入可能创下纪录。这一展望意味着价格走强有望支撑供应商收入，同时增加AI硬件采购方的成本；相关数字仍属于业绩预期，尚非已公布的季度结果。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Samsung and SK hynix Race to Secure ASML EUV Tools
title.zh: 三星与SK海力士争相锁定ASML EUV设备

summary.en: Samsung and SK hynix are racing to secure ASML EUV equipment amid constrained availability, Chosunbiz reports. Tool delivery slots could become a limiting factor for the timing of manufacturing expansion, even where financing and customer demand are available.
summary.zh: 据Chosunbiz报道，在ASML EUV设备供应受限的背景下，三星与SK海力士正争相锁定设备。即使资金和客户需求具备，设备交付排期仍可能制约制造产能扩张的时间表。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: China Reportedly Delays Nvidia H200 Imports to Support Domestic AI Chips
title.zh: 据报中国延缓Nvidia H200进口，以支持国产AI芯片

summary.en: China is delaying Nvidia H200 imports as it promotes domestic AI chips, according to Chosunbiz. The reported slowdown adds a customs bottleneck to accelerator procurement, making import clearance a separate constraint from product availability. It could affect deployment schedules and the hardware choices available to Chinese AI infrastructure buyers.
summary.zh: 据Chosunbiz报道，中国正延缓Nvidia H200进口，以推动国产AI芯片发展。报道中的延迟给加速器采购增加了通关瓶颈，进口放行成为产品供货之外的另一项约束。这可能影响中国AI基础设施采购方的部署时间表与硬件选择。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 财报与市场

title.en: indie's Core Chip Revenue Rises 14% Sequentially as Automaker Selects Its Radar
title.zh: indie核心芯片收入环比增长14%，雷达技术获车企选用

summary.en: indie Semiconductor's core chip revenue rises 14% from the previous quarter, and a top-three North American automaker selects its radar technology, MLQ.ai reports. The combination links a near-term sales recovery with a future automotive design opportunity, although a selection alone does not establish the timing or volume of production shipments.
summary.zh: 据MLQ.ai报道，indie Semiconductor核心芯片收入环比增长14%，其雷达技术同时获北美前三大车企之一选用。短期销售回升与未来汽车项目机会形成呼应，但获选本身尚不能确定量产出货的时间和规模。

theme.en: Moving Less Data Improves Compute Efficiency
theme.zh: 减少数据搬移，提升计算效率

dek.en: CIM macros and sensor compression circuits target the cost of moving and digitizing data, while GPU transport and MoE scheduling redistribute communication work. Device and clock-mesh studies examine how switching mechanisms and prediction accuracy shape design tradeoffs.
dek.zh: CIM宏与传感器压缩电路着眼于数据搬移和数字化的成本，GPU传输与MoE调度则重新分配通信任务。器件和时钟网格研究进一步考察开关机制与预测精度如何影响设计权衡。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Bulk-Silicon Transistor Combines Feedback and Thyristor Conduction
title.zh: 体硅晶体管结合正反馈与晶闸管导通机制

summary.en: A bulk-silicon p+-n-p-n+ transistor combines positive-feedback carrier injection with impact-ionization-assisted thyristor conduction and reports a subthreshold swing of about 10 mV/dec. Gate and drain biases select among three conduction regimes, including a bistable operating region. The steep switching is relevant to alternative device architectures, but the reported 3–5 V gate-bias range for the middle regime must be considered when assessing low-voltage integration.
summary.zh: 该体硅p+-n-p-n+晶体管结合正反馈载流子注入与碰撞电离辅助的晶闸管导通机制，报告的亚阈值摆幅约为10 mV/dec。栅极与漏极偏置可选择三种导通状态，其中包含双稳态工作区。陡峭开关特性为新型器件架构提供了思路，但评估低电压集成时，仍须考虑其中间工作区需要3—5 V栅极偏置这一条件。

title.en: Circuits & Interconnects
title.zh: 电路与互连

title.en: TD-dAJC Compresses Analog Video at 100 MS/s and 2 pJ per Pixel
title.zh: TD-dAJC以100 MS/s和每像素2 pJ实现模拟视频压缩

papers.authors: Harshit Naman, Gourab Barik, Yudhajit Ray, et al.

summary.en: TD-dAJC implements direct analog-to-MJPEG compression in 65-nm CMOS, reporting 100 MS/s throughput and 2 pJ per pixel. Pulse-width-encoded time weights and current integration perform DCT, quantization and associated arithmetic before digitization, reducing ADC workload. The result targets an important energy cost in always-on video sensors; the reported energy applies to the compression circuit.
summary.zh: TD-dAJC采用65 nm CMOS实现直接从模拟信号到MJPEG的压缩，报告吞吐率为100 MS/s、能耗为每像素2 pJ。电路通过脉宽编码的时间权重与电流积分，在数字化之前完成DCT、量化及相关运算，从而减轻ADC负担。该设计针对常开视频传感器中的重要能耗环节，所报告能耗对应压缩电路。

title.en: THz Through-Silicon Link Reaches 264 Gb/s With Offline Equalization
title.zh: 太赫兹穿硅互连借助离线均衡达到264 Gb/s

papers.authors: Chen Jiang, Xiao-Di Feng, Xiao-Han Shen, et al.

summary.en: THz-TSI demonstrates a wireless through-silicon interconnect at 264 Gb/s and 0.33 pJ/bit with offline equalization. The work supports both bidirectional point-to-point links and broadcast operation, addressing communication between vertically stacked device layers. Offline equalization is a material condition of the reported result, so integrating real-time equalization remains relevant to assessing a deployable link.
summary.zh: THz-TSI展示了一种无线穿硅互连，借助离线均衡实现264 Gb/s速率和0.33 pJ/bit能效。研究演示了双向点对点连接与广播模式，面向垂直堆叠器件层之间的通信。离线均衡是上述结果的重要条件，评估可部署链路时仍需考察实时均衡的集成。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: A 28-nm SRAM-CIM Macro Reduces Routing and Signed-MAC Overhead
title.zh: 28 nm SRAM-CIM宏降低布线与有符号MAC开销

papers.authors: Yun-Long Liu, Li-Chen Feng, Lin Wu, et al.

summary.en: A fabricated 28-nm, 32-kb SRAM-CIM macro occupies 0.072 mm² and supports INT8 and BF16 multiply-accumulate operations. Transition-counting lines compress partial-product signals without losing precision, while embedded sign extension adds 3% area overhead and no extra cycles. Stage-wise enabling suppresses spurious switching and improves energy efficiency by 42%, addressing circuit overhead that can erode CIM's data-movement advantage.
summary.zh: 这款已流片的28 nm、32 kb SRAM-CIM宏面积为0.072 mm²，支持INT8和BF16乘累加运算。跃迁计数线在不损失精度的前提下压缩部分积信号，嵌入式符号扩展仅增加3%面积且无需额外周期。分阶段使能抑制无效翻转，使能效提升42%，针对的是会削弱CIM数据搬移优势的电路开销。

title.en: A 28-nm 2.25-Mb RRAM-CIM Macro Reduces Weight-Access Overhead
title.zh: 28 nm、2.25 Mb RRAM-CIM宏降低权重访问开销

papers.authors: Jia-Ning Li, Chang Liu, Chang-Bao Xu, et al.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems Part 1: Regular Papers

summary.en: A fabricated 28-nm, 2.25-Mb RRAM-CIM macro combines hierarchical multi-bit storage coding with charge-domain continuous access. Measurements report a 2.5 ns single-read latency, 0.12 pJ/bit read energy and 12.85 Mb/mm² storage density. The design targets the density and access costs of storing transformer weights on chip; these macro-level metrics help assess that tradeoff without establishing full-system inference efficiency.
summary.zh: 这款已流片的28 nm、2.25 Mb RRAM-CIM宏，将分层多比特存储编码与电荷域连续访问结合。实测单次读取时延为2.5 ns，读取能耗为0.12 pJ/bit，存储密度为12.85 Mb/mm²。设计针对片上存储Transformer权重的密度与访问成本，这些宏级指标有助于评估相关权衡，但尚不能据此确定整个推理系统的能效。

title.en: AI Models & Inference Systems
title.zh: AI模型与推理系统

title.en: OpenRDMA Moves GPU Communication Submission Into an 8-Byte Token
title.zh: OpenRDMA以8字节令牌提交GPU通信请求

papers.authors: Ziheng Ji, Chunyu Liu, Weihao Peng, et al.

summary.en: OpenRDMA lets a GPU submit an 8-byte token while a dedicated FPGA NIC reconstructs the full work-queue entry from preconfigured context. Its transport supports per-packet multipath delivery, out-of-order arrivals and selective retransmission, with ordered DMA placement and GPU-visible completion flags. The preprint offers a concrete architecture for reducing communication control overhead in AI clusters, with deployment benefits dependent on NIC integration.
summary.zh: OpenRDMA让GPU只提交8字节令牌，再由专用FPGA网卡依据预配置上下文重建完整工作队列条目。其传输机制支持逐包多路径、乱序到达和选择性重传，并通过有序DMA放置与GPU可见的完成标志保证数据使用顺序。这篇预印本为降低AI集群的通信控制开销提供了具体架构，实际部署收益仍取决于网卡集成。

title.en: GC-MoE Separates GPU Communication and FP8/FP4 Expert Computation
title.zh: GC-MoE分离GPU通信与FP8/FP4专家计算

papers.authors: Yong Li, Kan Liu, Tao Lan

summary.en: GC-MoE uses CUDA Green Contexts to allocate a small GPU partition to token dispatch and a larger partition to FP8/FP4 grouped GEMM on Hopper and Blackwell. Separate kernels, resource budgets and synchronization domains allow dispatch and computation to overlap while being tuned independently. The preprint targets MoE decode with 1–256 tokens per rank, where dispatch overhead and weight traffic can limit tensor-core utilization.
summary.zh: GC-MoE利用CUDA Green Contexts，在Hopper与Blackwell上划分较小的GPU分区负责token分发，较大的分区负责FP8/FP4分组GEMM。独立的内核、资源预算与同步域，使分发和计算能够重叠执行并分别调优。这篇预印本面向每个rank仅有1—256个token的MoE解码场景，此时分发开销与权重流量可能限制Tensor Core利用率。

title.en: EDA & Design Automation
title.zh: EDA与设计自动化

title.en: GNN Surrogate Predicts Clock-Mesh Timing and Power Under Variation
title.zh: GNN代理模型预测工艺波动下的时钟网格时序与功耗

papers.authors: Muhammad Hadir Khan, Wajid Ali, Arya Thottiparambil Manikandan, et al.

summary.en: A graph-neural-network surrogate trained on SPICE data predicts clock-mesh timing and power while accounting for on-chip variation. On unseen real designs, average errors are 3.40 ps for delay, 4.14 ps for slew and 4.46 ps for skew; power predictions are within 3.4% of SPICE on average. This offers more detailed guidance for clock-mesh design-space exploration, although the reported accuracy measures agreement with simulation.
summary.zh: 该图神经网络代理模型以SPICE数据训练，在考虑片上波动的同时预测时钟网格时序与功耗。在未参与训练的真实设计上，延迟、转换时间和时钟偏斜的平均误差分别为3.40 ps、4.14 ps和4.46 ps，功耗相对SPICE的平均预测误差为3.4%。这为时钟网格设计空间探索提供了更细致的依据，但所报告精度衡量的是与仿真结果的一致性。
